newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Rugby body to appeal Super League ruling.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Rugby body to appeal Super League ruling.

text.p: The Australian Rugby League (ARL) said on Thursday it had been granted the right to an expedited application for leave to appeal against a court ruling which gave the green light to a rival competition run by News Ltd, the Australian media outlet of Rupert Murdoch's News Corp.
The ARL, the sport's traditional ruling body, said its application for leave to appeal against the ruling would be heard at the Australian High Court on November 15 .
"If such leave is granted, the High Court will then set a date for the hearing of the appeal," it added.

The Federal Court of Australia ruled on October 4 in favour of a News Ltd appeal against an earlier court decision which would have effectively banned Super League from kicking off in Australia until the end of the century.
News Ltd has said since then that it intends to approach top ARL players and offer them the chance to play in the Super League, which Murdoch also runs in Europe.
The ARL's major backer is unlisted pay-television operator Optus Vision, a competitor in Australia to News Ltd's Foxtel.
